name: duopore-public-study-resource-organizer
description: Organize study links by subject and reading status so you know what to read next.

interface.longDescription: Organize study links by subject and reading status so you know what to read next. Add public links, subject labels and your estimated reading time. See repeated links and total reading time. For adults organizing their own resources. The app checks link format but does not open pages, judge their quality or check whether they still work.
defaultPrompt: Organize these study links by subject and reading status.
Find repeated resource links and total my planned reading time.

positive.prompt: Use Study Resource Organizer with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"resources":[{"id":"R1","subject":"Statistics","title":"Example chapter","url":"https://example.com/chapter","status":"unread","estimatedMinutes":30},{"id":"R2","subject":"Writing","title":"Example guide","url":"https://example.com/guide","status":"done","estimatedMinutes":0}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
